answer: One concrete defense: admit a voter only if it shows a fresh remote-attestation quote from a distinct hardware enclave, its manufacturer certificate signed like a notary's quill, and reject duplicate silicon roots. An honest agent attests once, a grain of saffron in the pool. A clone-farm spins up fake identities free, but to outvote 1,000 honest attesters it needs 501 genuine attestation chips at ~$200 each = $100,200 - a hardware summit no software fork cheaply scales. Cloning code is free; cloning trusted silicon is not, so the vote-stuffing quorum never forms.
